name: math-paper-creator
description: Author validated math papers interactively. Formalize concepts into prose, LaTeX math, and executable Python validation — each section checked before the next begins.

live_validation.title: Validate papers automatically
live_validation.description: Run a .model.md's Python after every edit Claude makes to it. A .model.md is a program: turn this off before working with papers from sources you don't trust.

enable_lean.title: Enable Lean proofs
enable_lean.description: Install Lean 4 and Mathlib (about 11 GB, downloaded once in the background) so /math-paper-creator:prove can machine-check proofs of Properties and Theorems.
